Blaster Master Boy.name: Blaster Master Boy
Blaster Master Boy.summary: Blaster Master Jr., known as Blaster Master Boy in North America and Bomber King: Scenario 2 (ボンバーキング シナリオ2?) in Japan, is an action video game developed by Aicom and published by Sunsoft. The game was released in 1991 for Game Boy. The game is a sequel to Robowarrior, a spin-off title in the Bomberman series by Hudson Soft. However, the game was marketed in western territories as a game in the Blaster Master series by Sunsoft.

Jeopardy! - Sports Edition.name: Jeopardy! Sports Edition
Jeopardy! - Sports Edition.summary: This handheld version differs from its Game Gear version though it does run along the same lines. While it does feature sports related questions ranging from football to baseball and soccer, it does not feature any digitized voices or likeness of either contestants or Alex Trebek, instead opting for generic cartoon-like characters instead.

Mickey Mouse - Magic Wands!.name: Mickey Mouse: Magic Wands!
Mickey Mouse - Magic Wands!.summary:
A great adventure with Magic Wands!
Hurry and rescue your friends from the wicked witch's castle!

Mickey Mouse and his friends have become lost while playing near the edge of the forest. Mickey's friends have been trapped in Yashja the wicked witch's castle. Hurry and rescue your friends, Mickey! Take the Magic Wands and begin your great adventure.

Mickey Mouse II.name: Mickey Mouse
Mickey Mouse II.summary: Mickey Mouse (Mickey Mouse II in Japan) is the third game in the Crazy Castle series, and the second starring Mickey Mouse. It was later released in North America as Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle 2 and in Europe as Hugo and Mickey Mouse.

Red October o Oe!.name: The Hunt for Red October
Red October o Oe!.summary: The Game Boy version offers the option to play as Ramius or the convoy commander of the Soviet Navy. It has eight stages, beginning in Greenland and ending on the Western Seaboard of the United States. The fifth stage shows Greek architecture, an Easter egg where the lost city of Atlantis has been unknowingly discovered. As the convoy commander, the player's mission is to sink the Red October, sparing no expense.
